facts.text: Steak tartare, raw, bring it fast. I've got a market to beat before the soup comes out, Bud.
facts.why: Gekko never says this and it is set in quote marks. A real Gekko line is 'Lunch is for wimps.'

fix_note.text: Steak tartare, raw, bring it fast. I've got a market to beat before the soup comes out, Bud.

facts.text: In Gekko's office, where greed is good.
facts.why: The 'greed is good' speech is given at the Teldar Paper shareholders' meeting, not in Gekko's office.
facts.fix: At the Teldar meeting, where greed is good.

facts.text: The office birthday on the trading floor.
facts.why: Bud visits Gekko's office on Gekko's birthday with a box of Cuban cigars. There is no trading floor birthday or cake.
facts.fix: The cigars Bud brought for Gekko's birthday.

facts.text: The power lunch Gekko doesn't bother eating.
facts.why: The sources do not show Gekko at a power lunch with steak tartare. The only food reference is Gekko mocking Teldar's executives for their steak lunches.
facts.fix: Gekko mocks the Teldar steak lunches.

facts.why: Bud does move into a penthouse on the East Side, but no source mentions sushi in it.

vibe.verdict: Power lunch bistro is on theme but safe, with invented lines for Gekko and a few scenes placed wrongly.
missing: Gekko's red suspenders and big phone
ideas: Swap 'Cheesecake' note for 'Bud's box of Cuban cigars, on Gekko's birthday.'
Swap the Gekko note for 'Lunch is for wimps.'
Rename 'Old fashioned' to 'The Teldar speech' with the note 'Greed is right. Greed works.'
Swap 'Carl's cheeseburger' note for 'Carl wants Bluestar kept running.'
